THE PROBLEM

A patch is a suggestion.
Evidence makes it reviewable.

Bug reports get buried in chat. Investigations happen in terminals. AI-generated fixes arrive without a reliable trail. PatchRoom keeps the handoff, failing test, candidate diff and verification result connected through Switch.

FOLLOW THE EVIDENCE

One room. Every handoff.

This browser walkthrough replays archived evidence from the actual November 6 run. It does not execute agents or code in your browser.

HONEST SCOPE
Verified behavior.
Explicit limits.
This was an automated local development case. Three real coding agents collaborated through Switch. The candidate passed the configured tests. No authenticated human decision was recorded.
Switch 0.31.0 omits the sender-type metadata required by PatchRoom’s review checks. Approval remains blocked. The CLI supports configured stdlib unittest projects; candidate Python runs locally as the user. It is not a security sandbox.
The hosted page presents evidence. Run the source locally with Switch Console to execute the workflow.
